title: Syrian Poppy Seed Encroute
description: A fresh, tender, energizing Syrian dish featuring ground poppy seeds, en-croute, and a balance of crispy crust and fluffy interior. Ideal for a quick breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground poppy seeds, flour, Parmesan cheese, egg, milk, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of butter in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the butter to form a triangle, and press the edges together to seal the encroute.
Place the encroutes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh parsley.
